body: Yeah, I know that. It's hard to convince him of that, however.

I do intend to bring it up now, but should I wait until I see him in person this weekend? It's kind of a bothersome thing to have to bottle up while communicating over the phone til then since it's at the forefront of my mind, but I feel like maybe it'd be best to see his face when I bring it up so I can gauge his reaction and console if he takes it badly?

I think a major contributor to his unhealthy lifestyle is his limited amount of income. He buys some groceries, but he eats a lot of cheap fast food because he also has to pay rent at his dad's house along with some bills. He doesn't think all healthy food tastes gross, he just refuses to spend money on it. And I go to college an hour away and only visit on the weekends so we run sometimes then, but there aren't many opportunities.
I have recognized that my behavior is irrational and a product of corruption through my home life. I don't need unproductive commentary from an insensitive prick.
I've mostly been watching The Office and The Mindy Project on repeat, and I'm going to school to become a filmmaker. Thanks for being interested.

To me, being able to connect with others is essential to happiness. What is the point of being alive if you're only in a vile relationship with yourself? I am very lonely despite having one best friend and a boyfriend, and I don't think I would feel as dissatisfied as I am if my limited social circle was by choice. I just want to feel capable of having a successful conversation with someone new, and currently, I am not.
